description:
The DK Generation frame marks the start of a new era for DK Bicycles. Handcrafted right here in the USA and available in 20.75” and 21” top tube options. This brakeless frame is built from 100% 4130 Chromoly with a clear coat raw finish, the Generation features a super steep 76.25º head tube angle designed for effortless nose manuals and sharp front-end control. Out back, an ultra-responsive 12.9”-13.1” rear end lets you slammed-set your wheel at 13” flat giving you the agility needed for technical street riding. Down low, a raised 11.9” bottom bracket height provides extra clearance to keep your cranks, pedals, and BB shell high above rails and ledges on heavy grinds. The Generation frame delivers modern geometry specifically for the technical street rider.

Top Tube Length 20.75" or 21"
